purpose: The published release whose durable state the candidate must upgrade from and roll back to. scripts/build-baseline-app.sh re-derives that release's app tree from its tag with the tag's own assembly script and upstream lock; scripts/state-compat-test.py runs both versions over one state directory.

upstream.receipt_note: size/sha256 are the v0.1.0 lock's receipt of the tag tarball and matched a fresh fetch on 2026-09-24. GitHub may re-encode tag tarballs; content_sha256 over the extracted shipped subtree is what the builder gates on.
